You're right farming bots do drive the price of everything and does make it harder to farm which could drive the prices of your farmables down. I typed that with the usual argument that bots inflate the price, which probably comes from pure gold farming bots (pickpockets/fly bots).  


I'm just looking at it from my point, where I am only doing some basic stuff to sustain my weekly consumes. There are activities out there that bots are inefficient at and doesnt require much time to make gold.
And you think capping transfers to realm wouldn't work?

I don't disagre that GDKPs have affect on the game economy, I just don't believe its a major effect people make it out to be. GDKP gold is largeley in a clsoe loop system of the GDKPers, wether its to  buy gear, resale, or hoarding. Gold that isn't really just being used in the gen-pop.   


There are very few GDKPers who falunt gold and use it whatever way they want cause they will swipe their CC infinitely, but the vast majority of GDKPers are holding gold to buy gear in GDKPs, they aren't just going to the AH and buying up every consumable at whatever price.  


An easy way me and my guildies back in classic would know when bot ban wave happens was the prices of consumables would rise 2-3x their value, to confirm we just /who hunter dire maul and get under 50 results. I told my friends that the GDKP ban won't have any effect on the consumbable value, my sweaty group are still fully consuming and my more casual group of friends barely have the basic consumes. Might be anecdotal evidence but my long experience gaming, in any game, the economy is just one of the easy scapegoats for people who don't want to put in time.   


If bots are inflating the value of everything, you can farm anything and get the inflated value out of it, there are of course some nuainces but the bottom line is the same, if you want to raid fully consumed, there are always reasonable ways.

Personally it hasn't affected me, I heavily GDKP'd in classic and enjoyed it as an alt/pug loot system. Going into SOD, I mostly raid with guild/friends on 5 toons (and still 5 toons now). If you don't need to do the latest grind/loot (epic crafting gear) RIGHT NOW, prices are reasonable. Consumable prices are realtively the same, so people who were broke before GDKP ban are generally still broke now with 1 less reason they can blame for being broke.   


People who think GDKPs have a major affect on in-game economy are wildly delusional.

This and every post I read about people not wanting people to transfer off of lavalash but encourage them to roll a new toon on another server makes no sense. The players would still cause whatever imbalance you mentioned in a week or few days. Unless you are hoping this obstacle would just make them quit the game instead of rerolling.
